instruction: Candid full-shot outdoor photograph of a sunny grassy lawn. In the foreground, the young girl in a white cardigan (R1) leans back, smiling happily as she pulls a thick rope with both hands. Directly behind her, the man in a brown sweater (R2) leans forward with a joyful smile, holding her waist to support her weight during the game. The background shows a soft-focus grassy field with trees. Natural daylight illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the grass and creating a warm, cheerful atmosphere.
